verdict.rationale: FireHydrant is a hosted SaaS incident-management platform, so choosing a data region or residency is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, residency options or regional hosting. The closest items, the AI tenant control and the audit logs, are adjacent privacy and security features and do not cover data location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
